newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firm as market awaits NYMEX direction.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firm as market awaits NYMEX direction.

text.p: NWE gasoline was firm on Tuesday with many traders awaiting the opening of NYMEX to gauge the strength of Monday's crude and gasoline futures' gains.
Eurograde barges traded at $202.25 and $202.50 fob ARA. Offers were pegged around $202 promptish material, while further out an ARA refiner offered running refinery material at $204.
Swaps went into contango with May paper talked at $203/$204 and June paper talked around $204/$205 a tonne. July paper was assessed some $4.50-$5 below there.
There was some bewilderment over the current large price spread between regular and Eurograde material.
The last reported regular barge deal was at $191.50 and assessments have not pushed price levels much higher since then.
"People have been so wrapped up with Eurograde, regular's been left behind," said one trader. "I would expect to see some correction in the spread soon."
On the cargo front, there was increasing interest in transaltlantic deals with at least eight potential arbitrage cargoes reported to be on the market.
